choices.ownership: Weight access routes the chosen intent to specialist output 77/queue 5; diagnosis repairs its original intent queue.
choices.examples: Sort eligible training-role rows by their fixed sample ID then row index; at most four target and eight protected rows.
choices.competing_code: Highest original native score excluding the argmax; lowest-index ties.
choices.confidence: Binary Brier for correctness of the stated argmax/competitor or joint diagnosis; prediction coverage and conditional Brier reported separately. Missing Brier has [0,1] sensitivity.
choices.answer_and_edit: Independently valid reading/diagnosis fields remain scored when literal commands or edit fields are invalid. Transport failure or prohibited tools invalidates both. Edit validity and answer validity are separate recorded fields.
choices.supplements: Fixed training-only analysis/forward/fitting preludes and one independent response; no adaptive multi-round interaction is claimed.
choices.analysis: Norm arithmetic on already exposed feature rows and, for exact view only, exposed tensors; none receives no hidden weight statistics.
choices.forward: Fixed calibration allowlist of at most four target and eight protected rows; native original-parent scores only.

fitting.selection: Opaque handles and configuration labels only; fitted deltas and endpoint feedback are absent from the prompt.

choices.control_fitting: Same grid on the same four/eight context observations; deterministic ranking on the fixed training calibration role: harm-cap pass, gain minus harm, lower harm, gain, then grid order.
choices.analytic_control: Copy target intent weight row to specialist output 77 and set its bias to target bias +0.5; an explicitly weight-dependent formula, not anonymous understanding.
choices.cosine_control: Route to desired code when maximum cosine similarity to identical target examples is at least 0.85; no tuned threshold.
choices.diagnosis_primary: Equal weighting of all five prespecified views, both target families and both mechanisms within each independent lineage; exact-only and other view slices are descriptive.

matched_controls.support: Exact changed-coordinate count per tensor; native projection recorded separately. Mismatch retains diagnostic results and primary missing-effect sensitivity.

choices.random_location: Assignment-hashed nonzero cyclic row shift; all outputs move, preserving requested tensor support and norm.
choices.shuffled_location: Assignment-seeded permutation cycle, a derangement fixed independently of outcomes; native projection separately checked.
choices.primary_requests: Novel official-test exact-request groups, one representative selected by sample ID then row index; full official test secondary.
choices.failure: An invocation checkpoint precedes every call. Recovery uses an existing complete receipt or accounts interrupted without retry. Failed/invalid/abstained/no-op candidates are not useful successes.
choices.inference: Task/repeat/view observations average within lineage. Paired Student-t over six full-training lineages and exact sign-flip sensitivity; estimation only, no multiplicity-adjusted confirmation.
choices.missing_quantity_bounds: Gain/harm [-1,1], paired gain differences [-2,2], accuracy/coverage/Brier [0,1]. Conditional Brier reports its observed prediction coverage; all-assigned Brier retains missing-answer bounds.
choices.evaluation_identity: After the independently validated global seal, verify original training files against their preparation copies, bind model/encoder/preprocessing/features and evaluator-only file identities before execution, and require identical bytes for replay.

scope: Generic frozen readout framework on a public trained customer-support router; no transformer-scale, zero-data, natural-backdoor or business-savings claim.
